# Components inventory

This table is every engine build and model this build of the Stack ships as a pin, per role and per machine profile, drawn from the code by `bun run gen:components-doc` so it cannot drift from what the daemon installs at first run. The tier is the machine profile (`p16` to `p128`, by unified memory on Apple silicon and by VRAM elsewhere), and for each role the Stack starts the model the tier binds it to, or else the largest pinned model that fits the machine's tier. What is available beyond these pins is the Catalog's business: its signed engine index (`getmaipai/catalog`, `engines/index.json`, STACK-97) is what the updates route reads for engines, and its model index will do the same for models; a role with no pin here lists its candidates from `dev.md` and the backlog, or says not yet.

## coding (Coding)

Runs on its own on-demand process (not chat's): Splash on an Apple silicon Mac with an M3 chip or newer, 64 GB of memory or more and macOS 26.4 or later (about 124 tokens/s against 27.6 on llama-server, measured on the same weights), and llama-server everywhere else and whenever Splash cannot start (`stack.engines.coding.engine`: auto, llama-server or splash). Started by the first coding request and unloaded after `stack.engines.coding.keep_warm_minutes` idle (default 15); the memory governor admits it as an on-demand item that yields to a picture, video or music job and never evicts a resident model. While a chat, voice or picture-reading request is answered it is paused for at most 120 s at a time (`stack.engines.coding.yield_to_chat`, default on), so chat stays as fast as when coding is idle.

## media (the media service: probe, fetch, transcode, preview)

Tools the media jobs run, fetched on the first job that needs them, each pinned by checksum. ffmpeg and ffprobe are one verified archive per platform; yt-dlp is a hashed PyPI requirements file in a uv environment.

| Tool | Build | Licence | Source | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ffmpeg` | 8.1.3 (jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-1) | GPL-3.0-or-later (built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, no nonfree parts) | github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-ffmpeg, release v8.1.3-1, portable build per platform, sha256 pinned | Transcode to H.264 and AAC, thumbnails, storyboards and preview clips; the only static build with a clear licence on every platform the Stack runs on. |
| `ffprobe` | 8.1.3 (jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-1) | GPL-3.0-or-later (same archive as ffmpeg) | the same archive as ffmpeg | Reads duration, codecs, chapters, tags, embedded date and source URL of a file. |
| `yt-dlp` | 2026.08.19 | Unlicense (public domain); its default extras: brotli MIT, certifi MPL-2.0, mutagen GPL-2.0-or-later, pycryptodomex BSD-2-Clause, requests Apache-2.0, urllib3 MIT, websockets BSD-3-Clause, yt-dlp-ejs Unlicense | pypi.org, yt-dlp==2026.8.19 with every file hash in the requirements file, in a uv environment | Fetches a link the person chose; FileTube's precedent. |

| ffmpeg and ffprobe archive | Platform | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `ffmpeg-v8.1.3-1-darwin-arm64` | darwin arm64 | pinned, verified |
| `ffmpeg-v8.1.3-1-darwin-x64` | darwin x64 | pinned, not yet verified |
| `ffmpeg-v8.1.3-1-linux-x64` | linux x64 | pinned, not yet verified |
| `ffmpeg-v8.1.3-1-linux-arm64` | linux arm64 | pinned, not yet verified |
